## Project intent

A music party app: guests join a room from their phone and vote on what plays
next. Built for house parties. The host controls the Spotify playback; guests
only vote.

## Known pitfalls

*(reported by the project owner — read before touching these areas)*

- **Spotify tokens**: Refresh tokens live in .data/tokens.json and are written on every refresh. Never log that file.
- **Websockets**: Socket.IO rooms must be re-joined after a server restart.
- **Boot order**: HOST_PASSWORD must be set in .env or the server refuses to start.
